title: The Frog That Slid
lines: Ravi was running to the pool.
He tripped and dropped his net.
A frog was hopping in the wet mud.
Ravi stopped and grabbed at it.
The frog slipped from his hand.
It went swimming off in the pool.
Ravi just grinned and sat in the mud.

questions.listenFor: His net, when he tripped. It is in the second line.
Swimming off in the pool. Listen for the -ing ending, which is what this lesson is about.

questions.ask: Why do you think Ravi grinned instead of getting cross?
questions.listenFor: Any reason is fine. Ask what was funny about him sitting in the mud.
